payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Recalibrate or repair stale test-cost budgets — monitored `just check-full` completed all lints/tests (39963 passed, 14 skipped) but failed current hard CPU ceilings for ace_settle_pilot, parser_create, and pilot_pause_delay; recent same-day cost records alternate pass/fail under stable call counts, with another workspace running a concurrent cost lane.

Verified the linked plan and the sole closed child sase-yh.5.4.1, including both child notes and commit 1a32558a2. Source audit confirmed _ensure_hidden_document_root now forwards the chop monotonic deadline into ensure_sidecar_sdd_clone, whose clone, retry sleep, pull Git runner, and lock factory all bound work to that deadline while the preexisting mismatch, dirty, missing-upstream, and unpublished-clone guards remain non-destructive. Focused deadline/recovery/queue/binding verification passed 52 tests. Published-core integration is complete: concurrent post-start commit 20c7b9804 ratcheted pyproject.toml and uv.lock to the first complete release 0.32.54 and sase-core-revision.txt to a6d40bad; ratchet reports are current, the exact published-floor probe returned ok, and core ancestry/source confirm schema-2 authenticated checkpoint recovery plus the star-alias, unconditional queue, release-format, and later machine-setup contracts. Other post-start commits 72b76bae6 and 562e855bc affect only ACE usage UI and pager chrome and need no integration; no commit landed after the epic commit. PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP sase-yh.5.4.1 note #1 is unrelated test-cost CPU-budget instability and was recorded as a new +1 on exact existing task sase-xc; no duplicate task was created. Epic-symbol audit was clean.
